title: Origin story: Ra
description: Ra was the sun god, self-created, who sails the sky by day in his barque and journeys through the underworld by night, battling the serpent Apophis to rise again each dawn. In his old age Isis tricked him into revealing his secret name, gaining power over him.

title: Ability profile: Ra
description: Ranked abilities: Solar power — rank 100/100; Endurance — rank 100/100; Creation — rank 98/100; Kingship — rank 95/100; Night-navigation — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Ra
description: Powers: The sun disk — light and life itself; The barque that crosses sky and underworld; A secret name holding his very essence.

title: Stamina feats: Ra
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Has made the night journey and dawn return every day since creation; Fights Apophis nightly without fail.

title: Crossover notes: Ra
description: Ra crosses naturally with: the sun, creation, kingship, the daily journey.

title: Cultural impact: Ra
description: The sun as god; the daily proof that darkness never finally wins.
